business: Alder Precision Manufacturing Co. (Precision Machining & Light Assembly)

redFlags: Repairs reclassified as capital expenditure: Unsupported as an EBITDA add-back. These are recurring spindle and way-cover rebuilds on 5-axis machines; they occur every year and are maintenance.
Customer concentration: Largest customer, Meridian Park Municipal Authority, is 36.4% of FY2025 revenue; top 5 are 85.6%.
yellowFlags: Warranty / scrap reserve release: Negative adjustment. A $52,000 reserve release inflates June-2025 margin and TTM EBITDA; it should be removed.
Facility relocation costs: Supportable but outside the TTM. The move occurred in May-Jun 2024; it cannot be added back to a TTM ending December 2025.
Owner compensation normalization: Partially supportable. $60,000 of the $110,000 claim survives once a plant-manager replacement at $260,000 is priced in.

Seasonality and net working capital swing: FY2025 monthly EBITDA ranges from $12,520 to $193,799; cash ranges from $7,493,517 to $10,862,564. The NWC peg must be set on a 12-month average, not a period-end snapshot.
greenFlags: Verified TTM Revenue of $14.51M across VDR financials.
Reported TTM EBITDA of $1.28M reconciled against tax returns and bank statements.
